<a id="summary"></a>

## Summary

Each deliverable a pod template names has an owner role and stages; the first stage is recorded while a late member keeps working; a recorded stage is sent as one request to the role the template names for write-back, which outlives the pod.

<a id="goals"></a>

## Goals

- A pod's result has an owner, is not held up by its slowest member, and reaches the seat that keeps the knowledge.

<a id="non-goals"></a>

## Non-goals

- Changing how outputs are recorded (`pij output`).

<a id="execution-guardrails"></a>

## Execution Guardrails

- Cost: one writer commit per stage and one request per write-back; no loop, poll or timer.
- No permission rule changes (PRD 003); no daemon enforcement of a type's rules; no existing JSON field removed or renamed.
- Builds nice-19 through `just shared-build`, one at a time.
